name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 2
pathways: positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: MAP2K2 encodes dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 2. Annotated molecular activities include MAP kinase kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (autosomal dominant); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome 4 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
